steps.label: Exemption Power
steps.caption: Central government issues statutory notifications in public interest.

steps.label: Strict Construction
steps.caption: Constitutional bench rules ambiguity resolves in favor of revenue.

steps.label: Sunset Clause
steps.caption: Conditional customs exemptions expire after two financial years.

steps.label: End Use Monitoring
steps.caption: Concessional rate rules require digital bonds and consumption logs.

steps.label: Pilferage Relief
steps.caption: Importer bears no liability for goods pilfered before clearance.

steps.label: Custodian Liability
steps.caption: Terminal custodian assumes statutory liability for pilfered cargo.

steps.label: Proportional Abatement
steps.caption: Damaged goods duty is abated in direct ratio to diminution in value.

steps.label: Duty Remission
steps.caption: Accrued customs duty is fully remitted upon accidental destruction.

steps.label: Facility Licensing
steps.caption: Manufacturing unit receives bonded warehouse license under statute.

steps.label: Capital Deferment
steps.caption: Customs duties on imported machinery are deferred indefinitely.

steps.label: Export Duty Waiver
steps.caption: Raw material customs duties are completely waived upon final export.

steps.label: Domestic Clearance
steps.caption: Domestic clearances pay duty solely on consumed raw material fraction.

steps.label: Unused Re-Exports
steps.caption: Ninety-eight percent of customs duty is refunded on unused goods.

steps.label: Used Goods Scale
steps.caption: Sliding scale reduces drawback based on duration of domestic use.

steps.label: Industry Rates
steps.caption: All industry rates provide standardized average drawback percentages.

steps.label: Market Value Cap
steps.caption: Drawback is denied if claimed amount exceeds domestic market value.

steps.label: Abatement Formula
steps.caption: Engine computes proportional duty abatement for damaged consignments.

steps.label: Bonded Lot Tracking
steps.caption: Software tracks capital assets and raw material inventory batches.

steps.label: Drawback Optimizer
steps.caption: System evaluates industry rates against brand rate cost records.

steps.label: Statutory Ledger
steps.caption: Automated engine generates compliance registers for customs audit.
